shapes.name: Postgres namespace `app` (appSchema) and the migration journal apps/platform/db/drizzle
The client-resource file layout under `CLIENT_RESOURCE_ROOT`: `<clientId>/<resourceId>/original`, `page-<n>`, `thumbnail`
`app.coach_availability` and `app.coach_meeting_room` (the two one-row singleton tables migration `0024_create_coach_availability_and_meeting_room.sql` creates)
`app.coach_time_reservations` (start and end, no appointment columns), referenced by the `reservation_id` of each appointment table (`app.assessment_calls`, `app.check_ins`)
`app.waitlist_entries.reduced_slot` and its constraints
`app.feature_flags`, including `WAITLIST_MODE`
`app.product_types` and `app.product_goals` reference rows (three product types, four product goals)
store zod contracts (public/store.ts, store-management.ts)
waitlist zod contracts (public/waitlist.ts)
assessment-call zod contracts (public/assessment-calls.ts)
coach-schedule zod contracts (`public/coach-schedule-settings.ts`, `public/time-zone.ts`, `public/paths.ts`)
The call-moment wording in shared/time-format (`formatCallMoment`, `formatDayFirstDate`, `formatMonthFirstDate`, `formatMonthFirstDay`, `formatClockTime`, `nameTimeZone`)
The assessment-call rule literals (ASSESSMENT_CALL_RULES: duration, buffer, step, horizon, lead)
The subaddress refusal: `EmailSubaddressPolicy` (`allowed \| refused`) and the error code `email_subaddress_refused`
accounts contracts (PublicSessionState, accountResponseSchema, the invitation resolution schemas and `InvitationResolution`) and the access bounded context's AccountRole
BotDetectionSettings (zod schema in shared/submission-checks)
FeatureFlagSnapshot (featureFlagSnapshotSchema)
The request's feature-flag override set (`Readonly<FeatureFlagSet>` in an `AsyncLocalStorage`) and the `__eli_feature_flags` cookie
RuntimeEnvironment
Route path literals
The offer-plan literal `"all-bundles"`
WaitlistPresentation (mode, isClosed, isUnavailable, showsAuthControls, availabilityStatus, bundleOfferPlan)
C18's tables (`app.payment_links`, `app.checkout_sessions`, `app.coaching_subscriptions`, `app.payment_cards`) with foreign keys to C17's `app.assessment_calls` and C24's `app.clients`

C20's onboarding tables (`app.client_onboarding_drafts`, `app.client_onboarding_submissions`, `app.client_onboarding_reviews`, `app.client_onboarding_detail_requests`) with foreign keys to C24's `app.clients`; migrations 0029, 0031 and 0032

C20's profile tables (`app.client_profiles`, `app.client_measurements`, `app.client_settings`, `app.client_progress_photos`, `app.client_avatars`) with foreign keys to C24's `app.clients` (and the photos to `client_measurements`); the profile and settings rows opened through the clients bounded context's client-profile facade inside the paid checkout's unit of work; migrations 0029, 0033, 0034 and 0059
`app.payment_events` (the payment-event ledger: event id, received at)
Payment metadata key `purpose` (`PAYMENT_PURPOSE_METADATA_KEY`) and its values
Coaching bundle value lists (`COACHING_BUNDLE_IDS`, `COACHING_BUNDLE_MONTHS`, `PRICE_TIERS`, and each bundle's `currency`)

coaching-sales zod contracts (public/coaching-sales.ts, bundle-cards.ts, client-subscription.ts, program-status.ts, paths.ts) and loader data (`BundlePage`, `CheckoutConfirmation`, `CallSales`, pricing tiers, bundle cards, `ProgramStatus`, `ClientSubscription`)
PaymentsConfig (`PAYMENTS_PROVIDER`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET`, `STRIPE_API_BASE_URL`)
localStorage cart (STORE_CART_STORAGE_KEY)

`app.check_ins` (id, client, start, the client's and the coach's zones, kind, recorded status, initiating and proposing party, note, requested and answered moments) with foreign keys to C24's `app.clients` and, through `reservation_id`, to C23's `app.coach_time_reservations`; migration 0040
check-ins zod contracts (`public/check-ins.ts`, `public/paths.ts`) and loader data (the client's and the coach's check-in lists, the open times)
The calendar invite attachment (an `.ics` with `METHOD:PUBLISH`, content type `text/calendar; charset=utf-8; method=PUBLISH`, filename `invite.ics`)
Email HTML rendered from React primitives (Email*), the email theme (`EMAIL_COLORS`, `EMAIL_FONTS`), the brand frame (`EMAIL_FRAME_STYLES`) and the primary button (`EMAIL_PRIMARY_BUTTON_STYLE`)
CLERK_TEST_ENVIRONMENT and the Stripe webhook signature scheme (`./stripe-webhook-signature`)
The auth subject id: `app.accounts.auth_subject_id` (C9) and `app.clients.auth_subject_id` (C24, unique, no foreign key)
The client journey step (`ClientJourneyStep`: `welcome \| onboarding \| submitted \| in-review \| needs-details \| approved`) and its paths
The client status (`CLIENT_STATUSES`: `invited \| onboarding \| awaiting-review \| in-review \| needs-details \| approved \| active \| cancelled \| inactive`)
Clerk invitation public metadata `invitationId`
C24's table (`app.clients`) with the client's foreign key to C17's `app.assessment_calls`; migrations 0026–0030, 0045 (the standing columns and `booking_time_zone`) and 0064 (`account_invitation_id`)

clients zod contracts (public/client-journey.ts, coach-clients.ts, client-status.ts, clients.ts, client-identity.ts, paths.ts) and loader data (`ClientIdentity`, `WelcomePage`, `ClientRosterPort`, `CoachClient`)
The coaching standing on `app.clients` (`coaching_status`, `coaching_access_ends_at`, `coaching_refund_due`, `coaching_bundle_months`)

Bell entries: C27's `app.notifications` (recipient party and client, `kind`, `facts` jsonb, arrival, read moment, partial unique `once_key`; foreign key to C24's `app.clients`; migration 0051) storing each writer's `kind` and `facts` opaquely; C22 owns `CHECK_IN_BELL_KINDS` and `CHECK_IN_BELL_FACTS` (`public/check-in-bell.ts`), so a facts-schema change must still parse every row of the 90-day window
notifications zod contracts (`public/notifications.ts`, `public/paths.ts`: the bell, `NotificationDescriber`) and loader data (the bell both shell loaders read)
The account invitation id: `app.clients.account_invitation_id` (C24, unique, no foreign key) names C9's `app.account_invitations` row; migration 0064

groups.name: vertical-feature-slice
groups.absorbs: one user-visible capability delivered end to end, from the domain rule to the surface that registers it

groups.name: waiting-list-mode
groups.absorbs: how waiting-list mode is stored, read and switched

groups.name: coach-scheduling
groups.absorbs: the coach's own time and room: slot policy, reservations, overlap rules, window and meeting room

groups.name: adapter-facing-contracts
groups.absorbs: a change to the email, bot-detection, management-auth or payments contract and every sender, verifier or handler of it

groups.name: design-system
groups.absorbs: a token, primitive or shared look changed once in the design system and taken up by every consumer

groups.name: coach-portal
groups.absorbs: a coach-facing block: the use case and port, the portal primitive, the component's coach UI and the page that composes it

groups.name: operations-bounded-context
groups.absorbs: a change to the operator switches and their persisted flags, inside the operations bounded context and its facade

groups.name: legal-bounded-context
groups.absorbs: a change to the legal documents, their versions and the terms facade, inside the legal bounded context

groups.name: access-bounded-context
groups.absorbs: a change to accounts, sessions and portal access, inside the access bounded context and its published session and invitation entries

groups.name: scheduling-bounded-context
groups.absorbs: a change to the coach's time and the assessment call, inside the scheduling bounded context and its facades

groups.name: clients-bounded-context
groups.absorbs: a change to who a client is and what she receives (profile, onboarding, resources, bell, check-ins), inside the clients bounded context and its facades

groups.name: programs-bounded-context
groups.absorbs: a change to the coach's exercise and nutrition libraries, inside the programs bounded context

groups.name: sales-bounded-context
groups.absorbs: a change to what is sold and how (store, waitlist, coaching sales), inside the sales bounded context
